metadata.title: An improved second pinching theorem for minimal hypersurfaces with constant scalar curvature in spheres
metadata.abstract: Let $M^n$ be a closed minimal hypersurface of the unit sphere with constant squared norm $S$ of the second fundamental form. For $n\geq4$, we prove that $S>n$ implies $S>85n/59$, improving the bound $10n/7$ of Suh and Yang. No constancy assumption is imposed on the cubic trace $f_3$. The proof combines a symmetrized Hessian estimate, an integral identity for a mixed moment, and a weighted estimate for the repeated-index components of the covariant derivative of the second fundamental form. An exact polynomial argument treats the entire excluded interval. We also prove an explicit positive lower bound for the average of the normalized quadratic defect $P/S^2$, where $P=f_4-f_3^2/S-S^2/n$. This second estimate holds in every dimension $n\geq2$ and gives a quantitative obstruction to concentration near the locus of two principal curvatures.

analysis.workSummary: 对球面中闭极小超曲面，在第二基本形式平方范数 S 恒定且 n≥4 时，将第二间隙下界从 10n/7 改进到 85n/59；另给归一化二次缺额的平均正下界。
analysis.breakthrough: 无需假设三次迹恒定，并定量阻止主曲率向二值轨迹集中。
analysis.limitations: 第二间隙结论有闭性、极小性、S 恒定及维数限制；这是夹逼常数改进，不是完整解决 Chern 猜想。 已补读PDF第1–3页定理1.1、1.2及方法说明，确认不要求三次迹恒定；平均缺额定理和夹逼定理维数条件不同。 未逐行审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索及命中核查记录；未见披露不代表未使用 AI。
